assertions: Consumed original published property-set/state algorithms now use actual Any/Property/Sequence, original singleton/vector listener containers, actual weak roots and actual non-interface broadcast base ownership. They preserve source name/handle/readonly checks, conversion/storage/veto/bound ordering, dependent-before-primary events, source exception filters and static-versus-dynamic wrapping, hook-before-empty-count and notification flags, copied snapshots, native default/current equality, state reset and original early-break bulk state behavior. Native event const-field projections acquire/copy nothing; generated SDK copy/equality accepts the same actual fields. Compiler MI flattening uses one supplied zero-argument OWeakObject-based root, a distinct propertySet_m_pReserved to preserve the native weak base field, an explicit self-cast token and qualified destructor bindings; non-interface composition represents the original broadcast base subobject. readFastPropertyValue names only the original protected output overload. Mutex member/GetMutex/scopes, physical C++ ABI/allocator/MI casts and nonweak/argument-bearing root bindings remain unqualified, with no fake locks, value stores, service/type providers or registered metadata substitutes. Authored critical tests and adapted qadevOOo XPropertyState4/XMultiPropertySet6 entry points cover the configured sal_Int32 caller; Java proxy/event harness and other ValueChanger configurations remain unqualified. Actual Chromium main/DOM-free Worker confirms long storage versus short notification, old/current/default states, real Source identity and seven original type entries. UNO OPropertyBag, SfxDocumentMetaData and final DOCX/XLSX core/shell/UI acceptance remain unfinished.
